method: All 30 families lead a mixed team against six Guardian rematches and four final arena matches at equal level, three seeds, three fixed policies. Exact real engine. No tonics. Full-party HP available at entry.
limitations: Synthetic equal-level fixtures, not observed players, campaign pacing or proof of optimal balance. Rematches include one Guardian, not the campaign finale echoes. Every family has two fixed supports; results describe the whole team.
